newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan Intl Comml Bank to open at Subic.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan Intl Comml Bank to open at Subic.

text.p: Taiwan's International Commercial Bank of China said on Wednesday it would open a branch office in the Philippines' Subic Bay on Monday.

The bank said in a statement the branch aimed to provide service to Taiwan companies and executives investing in an ambitious government-sponsored commercial and industrial development at the former U.S. military base.

Worried that its businessmen could become too dependent on longtime rival China, Taiwan's government launched what it called its "south-bound policy" in late 1993 to promote investment in Southeast Asia rather than the communist mainland.
The bank already has two branches in the Philippines.
